scope: Chapters 1-end, all routes; cumulative source review

edits.speaker: Beecha
edits.before: Wh-why, it was nothing, really...
edits.after: N-no, it was nothing, really...
edits.reason: Beecha's embarrassed denial is not a question asking why.

edits.speaker: Saegusa
edits.before: During the Lizard War, it seems the Nadesico earned quite a grudge from those guys.
edits.after: During the Lizard War, the Nadesico seems to have earned those guys' lasting resentment.
edits.reason: A ship earns someone's resentment; it does not earn a grudge from them.

edits.speaker: Bright
edits.before: And if Neo Zeon remnants or the hawks exiled from Mokuren were to side with him...
edits.after: And if Neo Zeon remnants or the hardliners expelled from the Jovian Federation were to side with him...
edits.reason: Expand the untranslated faction abbreviation and preserve the conditional alliance warning.

edits.speaker: Altair
edits.before: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
edits.after: I'll let you live... for now!
edits.reason: Altair grants his opponent a temporary reprieve; leaving a fate be is not natural English.

edits.speaker: Koji
edits.before: You'd better remember this, you bastard!
edits.after: You'll pay for this, you bastard!
edits.reason: The defeat line is a revenge threat, not a literal instruction to remember something.

edits.speaker: Rockfell
edits.before: Saiga... I... end here...
edits.after: Saiga... This is... the end for me...
edits.reason: Rockfell's interrupted dying line needs natural English rather than I end here.

edits.speaker: Karl
edits.before: Exactly! To recapture the D-Weapons, too, we should take on the Gundam Team ourselves!
edits.after: Exactly! To ensure we recapture the D-Weapons, we should take on the Gundam Team ourselves!
edits.reason: Make the causal link between clearing the pursuers and recovering the weapons clear.

edits.speaker: Karl
edits.before: Just what I'd expect from Captain Bright Noa, the renowned captain. You won't let us have our way so easily!
edits.after: Just what I'd expect from Bright Noa, the renowned captain. You won't let us have our way so easily!
edits.reason: Avoid calling Bright a captain twice; retain his ship-command role without imposing an uncertain rank conversion.

edits.speaker: Roux
edits.before: Before that, is it an enemy or an ally?
edits.after: More importantly, is it an enemy or an ally?
edits.reason: The speaker prioritizes identifying allegiance; before that misleadingly suggests a time sequence.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: Its existence was predicted alongside the four forces: gravity, electromagnetism, the strong interaction and the weak interaction.
edits.after: Its existence was predicted in addition to the four forces: gravity, electromagnetism, and the strong and weak interactions.
edits.reason: Terminus Energy is described as an additional force, not one predicted alongside the four established forces.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: Like the TE Engine, Lasmunanium is a new material developed by Dr. Zapat...
edits.after: Lasmunanium is a new material developed by Dr. Zapat, who also developed the TE Engine...
edits.reason: The shared feature is the inventor; the TE Engine itself is not a material.

edits.speaker: Bright
edits.before: More to the point, Lieutenant #女愛称... Does Lasmunanium have the same properties as DG Cells?
edits.after: More to the point, Ensign #女愛称... Does Lasmunanium have the same properties as DG Cells?
edits.reason: Use the same rank as the pilot's introduction and Bright's earlier order; the Japanese rank is unchanged.

edits.speaker: Dr. Saotome
edits.before: My Saotome Institute, your Institute of Space Science, Genzo Umon...
edits.after: My Saotome Institute, your Institute of Space Science, Dr. Umon...
edits.reason: Address the scientist as Dr. Umon, as the Japanese does, rather than inserting his full name into a formal address.

edits.speaker: Koji
edits.before: Hello, Genzo Umon. I'm Koji Kabuto.
edits.after: Hello, Dr. Umon. I'm Koji Kabuto.
edits.reason: Restore the respectful title in Koji's introduction.

edits.speaker: Daisuke
edits.before: A red moon... the signal fire for their sortie. ...You should contact the Earth Federation Forces. They will attack, without a doubt.
edits.after: A red moon... the signal that they're going on the offensive. ...Contact the Earth Federation Forces. They'll attack for certain.
edits.reason: Replace the literal signal fire for their sortie with the meaning of the warning, retaining the imminent attack.

edits.speaker: Koji
edits.before: Genzo Umon!
edits.after: Dr. Umon!
edits.reason: Restore the scientist's title in Koji's call rather than using his full name as an address.

edits.speaker: Blacky
edits.before: Then sound the true opening salvo of our invasion of Earth...!
edits.after: And mark the true beginning of our invasion of Earth...!
edits.reason: Avoid mixing sound with a salvo; the metaphor announces the invasion's true beginning.

edits.speaker: Daisuke
edits.before: Koji, it seems I couldn't fool your eyes...
edits.after: It seems I couldn't fool you, Koji...
edits.reason: Koji has recognized Daisuke; fool your eyes is unnecessarily literal English.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: ...I'm Second Lieutenant #女姓名, of the Federation Forces' Tsentr Project.
edits.after: ...I'm Ensign #女姓名, of the Federation Forces' Tsentr Project.
edits.reason: Use the established protagonist rank from the project glossary, matching the Real-route introduction.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: I'm Second Lieutenant #男姓名, also with the Federation Forces' Tsentr Project.
edits.after: I'm Ensign #男姓名, also with the Federation Forces' Tsentr Project.
edits.reason: Use the established protagonist rank from the project glossary, matching the Real-route introduction.

edits.speaker: Koji
edits.before: When you say adjust... does that have anything to do with that swimsuit-like outfit you're wearing, Lieutenant?
edits.after: When you say adjust... does that have anything to do with that swimsuit-like outfit you're wearing, Ensign?
edits.reason: Keep the protagonist's rank consistent with the glossary and introduction.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: Like the TE Engine, Lasmunanium is a new material developed by Dr. Zapat...
edits.after: Lasmunanium is a new material developed by Dr. Zapat, who also developed the TE Engine...
edits.reason: The shared feature is the inventor; the TE Engine itself is not a material.

edits.speaker: Genzo Umon
edits.before: Then, Lieutenant... Does Lasmunanium have properties similar to DG Cells?
edits.after: Then, Ensign... Does Lasmunanium have properties similar to DG Cells?
edits.reason: Keep the protagonist's rank consistent with the glossary and introduction.

edits.speaker: Bright
edits.before: Are they planning to invade the inside?
edits.after: Are they planning to penetrate the barrier?
edits.reason: The question concerns entering Tokyo Jupiter; invade the inside is awkward and imprecise.

edits.speaker: Misumaru
edits.before: I'm sorry to have put you to that trouble, Colonel.
edits.after: I'm sorry to have put you to that trouble, Captain.
edits.reason: Bright's established naval rank is Captain, matching the nearby forms of address and recorded Akurasu decision.

edits.speaker: Kaine
edits.before: What!? Who are you calling a trio of cons, huh!?
edits.after: What!? Who are you calling a trio of crooks, huh!?
edits.reason: A trio of cons sounds like drawbacks in English; crooks keeps Kaine's mishearing of the insult intelligible.

edits.speaker: Kaine
edits.before: ...Yes, it is.
edits.after: ...No, they're no different.
edits.reason: Kaine rejects Asuka's claim that her machine is fundamentally different; make the reply's polarity explicit.

edits.speaker: Meio
edits.before: Yes... the Dragonars are flying. When did they learn to do that?
edits.after: Yes... the Dragonars are flying. When did that happen?
edits.reason: The surprise concerns newly flying machines, not an unsupported claim that their pilots learned a skill.

edits.speaker: Light
edits.before: You're still trailing after the Blue Hawk like fish poop, aren't you?
edits.after: Still the Blue Hawk's little hangers-on, aren't you?
edits.reason: The goldfish-droppings expression means sycophantic followers, not literal fish waste.

edits.speaker: Misumaru
edits.before: Colonel, I see you've safely rendezvoused with the D-weapon transport fleet.
edits.after: Captain, I see you've safely rendezvoused with the D-Weapons transport fleet.
edits.reason: Use Bright's established naval rank and the consistent D-Weapons spelling.

edits.speaker: Misumaru
edits.before: ...The Earth Federation Army is bearing the brunt of problems on all sorts of fronts.
edits.after: ...The Federation Forces are bearing the brunt of problems on all sorts of fronts.
edits.reason: The reference includes both space and ground forces; Army incorrectly narrows it to one service.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: Likewise... I'm Second Lieutenant #女姓名.
edits.after: Likewise... I'm Ensign #女姓名.
edits.reason: Keep the protagonist's established rank consistent.

edits.speaker: Light
edits.before: Lieutenant, please don't flatter him too much. It'll only go to his head even more.
edits.after: Ensign, please don't flatter him too much. It'll only go to his head even more.
edits.reason: Keep the protagonist's established rank consistent.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: Normal... do they?
edits.after: Normal... really?
edits.reason: Smooth the skeptical thought about the male pilot's supposedly normal clothes.

edits.speaker: Kaine
edits.before: You can just call me Kaine, Lieutenant. So, what is it?
edits.after: You can just call me Kaine, Ensign. So, what is it?
edits.reason: Keep the protagonist's established rank consistent.

edits.speaker: Misumaru
edits.before: ...Colonel. After the postwar cleanup of the Neo Zeon and Baam wars, now this mission...
edits.after: ...Captain. After the postwar cleanup of the Neo Zeon and Baam wars, now this mission...
edits.reason: Use Bright's established naval rank consistently.

edits.speaker: #女愛称
edits.before: I'm Second Lieutenant #女姓名...
edits.after: I'm Ensign #女姓名...
edits.reason: Use the established female protagonist rank consistently.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: I'm Second Lieutenant #男姓名. I'll be counting on you from now on.
edits.after: I'm Ensign #男姓名. I'll be counting on you from now on.
edits.reason: Use the established male protagonist rank consistently.

edits.speaker: Blacky
edits.before: Japan, sir? The solar system's fifth planet...
edits.after: Japan, sir? There's a barrier there resembling the solar system's fifth planet...
edits.reason: Start the comparison with the barrier in Japan, so Japan itself cannot be mistaken for the fifth planet.

edits.speaker: Blacky
edits.before: ...the planet those Earthlings call Jupiter... There's a strange barrier there that looks just like it, but...
edits.after: ...the one the Earthlings call Jupiter. It's a rather unusual barrier...
edits.reason: Complete the paired comparison naturally while retaining the description of the special barrier.

edits.speaker: Kunugi
edits.before: Colonel, I would like your forces to keep watch around the outside.
edits.after: Captain, I would like your forces to keep watch around the outside.
edits.reason: Use Bright's established naval rank consistently.

edits.speaker: Bright
edits.before: Granted. Everyone except Second Lieutenant #男愛称, keep watch on the surrounding area!
edits.after: Granted. Everyone except Ensign #男愛称, keep watch on the surrounding area!
edits.reason: Keep the protagonist's established rank consistent.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: Damn it! If only there was nothing wrong with my body...!
edits.after: Damn it! If only my body were all right...!
edits.reason: Smooth Hugo's frustrated thought about his physical condition.

edits.speaker: Dr. Hibiki
edits.before: There does seem to be some connection between Raideen and that OOPArts...
edits.after: There does seem to be some connection between Raideen and the OOPArts...
edits.reason: Avoid combining the singular demonstrative that with the established OOPArts term.

edits.speaker: Misumaru
edits.before: Yes... Far East Command headquarters asked me to help, taking the Vegan Empire attacks and Dolem appearance seriously.
edits.after: Yes... Far East Command has asked me to help, taking the Vegan Empire attacks and the appearance of Dotems seriously.
edits.reason: Correct Dolem to Dotem: the source names the Dotems fought in this battle. Also clarify the request from headquarters.

edits.speaker: Ginga
edits.before: It's not a dance! It's Shaolin kung fu, you idiot!
edits.after: It's not a dance! It's Shorinji Kempo, you idiot!
edits.reason: Use the name of the specific martial art in the source, Shorinji Kempo, rather than the different, general term Shaolin kung fu. Official terminology: https://www.shorinjikempo.or.jp/en/what/discipline

edits.speaker: Hokuto
edits.before: Ginga, that move! You know, the kung fu move you were doing earlier! Let's try it!
edits.after: Ginga, that move! You know, the martial arts move you were doing earlier! Let's try it!
edits.reason: Use martial arts for the general reference to Ginga's fighting style, consistent with the named Shorinji Kempo introduction.

edits.speaker: Ginga
edits.before: I know! More importantly, follow my kung fu moves!
edits.after: I know! More importantly, follow my martial arts moves!
edits.reason: Use martial arts for the general reference to Ginga's fighting style, rather than relabeling it as kung fu.

edits.speaker: Bright
edits.before: Captain Bright Noa, captain of the Nahel Argama, reporting, sir.
edits.after: Captain Bright Noa of the Nahel Argama, reporting, sir.
edits.reason: Avoid repeating captain in the self-introduction while preserving Bright's approved rank and command of the ship.

edits.speaker: Midori
edits.before: Who did you pick a fight with this time!? I've told you over and over, Shaolin kung fu isn't for that sort of thing...!
edits.after: Who did you pick a fight with this time!? I've told you over and over, Shorinji Kempo isn't for that sort of thing...!
edits.reason: Name the specific martial art correctly, matching Ginga's earlier introduction. Shorinji Kempo is the official English name, not Shaolin kung fu.

edits.before: C-Captain! The Army-type units are multiplying again!!
edits.after: C-Commander! The Army-type units are multiplying again!!
edits.reason: Uses Albero's squad-leader title consistently in the Cry Wolves flashback.

edits.before: C-Captain! The main body... The main body is starting to regenerate!!
edits.after: C-Commander! The main body... The main body is starting to regenerate!!
edits.reason: Uses Albero's squad-leader title consistently in the Cry Wolves flashback.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: Damn it! Are you saying it's... the Devil Gundam has come back!?
edits.after: Damn it! Are you saying... the Devil Gundam has come back!?
edits.reason: Remove the broken phrase 'it's... the Devil Gundam has' while preserving Hugo's shocked question about its revival.

edits.speaker: Meio
edits.before: ...Your Excellency... The situation facing the Earth and our people has already become too uncertain to predict.
edits.after: ...Your Excellency... The situation facing Earth and our people has already reached a critical point.
edits.reason: The expression warns that the situation is precarious and demands attention; it is stronger than merely saying it is hard to predict.

edits.speaker: Koji
edits.before: Dr. Genzo Umon just contacted us. He said he wants you to come back to the institute, Daisuke.
edits.after: Dr. Umon just contacted us. He said he wants you to come back to the institute, Daisuke.
edits.reason: Use the natural spoken form Dr. Umon for the source's title and surname, consistent with the earlier chapters.

edits.speaker: Danbei
edits.before: G-Genzo Umon! Something terrible's happened!
edits.after: D-Dr. Umon! Something terrible's happened!
edits.reason: Restore the title and surname used in this urgent address; the speaker does not call the doctor by his full given name.

edits.speaker: Hikaru
edits.before: Dad! Genzo Umon!
edits.after: Dad! Dr. Umon!
edits.reason: Restore the spoken title Dr. Umon rather than an unnatural full-name address.

edits.speaker: Daisuke
edits.before: It's understandable... Even after contact with the Baam, many people on Earth still haven't accepted that aliens exist...
edits.after: It's understandable... Even after contact with the Baam, many people on Earth still haven't accepted aliens...
edits.reason: The source concerns accepting aliens, not doubting that aliens exist. The surrounding scene is about the response to Daisuke's identity.

edits.speaker: Oki
edits.before: Locking him in solitary confinement to build his will to fight paid off. His combat balance is incredible for a middle schooler.
edits.after: Locking him in solitary confinement to build his will to fight paid off. His performance in combat is incredible for a middle schooler.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural calque 'combat balance' with the intended assessment of Masato's overall performance in battle.

edits.speaker: Altair
edits.before: D-damn you, Dendoh!! How dare you do this to me, Altair!!
edits.after: D-damn you, Dendoh!! How dare you defy Altair!!
edits.reason: Make Altair's boast natural in English while keeping his name audible: Vega recognizes that name in the next lines.

edits.speaker: Tapp
edits.before: Maybe you've even got some pinup photos hidden away.
edits.after: Maybe you've even got some photos of her hidden away.
edits.reason: The source means collectible portrait photographs. Pinup adds a suggestive meaning that is not specified in the Japanese.

edits.speaker: Vega
edits.before: When a Data Weapon finds what it seeks in a Commander's owner's heart... the condition for its contract...
edits.after: When a Data Weapon finds what it seeks in the heart of someone holding a Commander... its condition for a contract...
edits.reason: Replace the stacked possessive 'a Commander's owner's heart' with a clear description of the Commander holder and the contract condition.

edits.speaker: Eris
edits.before: They may have been drawn to the energy released by Last Guardian's mobile weapons.
edits.after: They may have been drawn to the energy released by Last Guardian's mobile weapon.
edits.reason: Use the singular: this scene refers to the energy released by Zeorymer, the one Last Guardian weapon just seen in battle.

edits.speaker: Asuka
edits.before: There's no way this Three Idiots Trio would ever take cleaning seriously.
edits.after: There's no way you three idiots would ever take cleaning seriously.
edits.reason: Make Asuka's insult natural English instead of treating Three Idiots Trio as an awkward capitalized title.

edits.speaker: Giga Absolute
edits.before: According to Chip's report, Dendoh's batteries have already been shipped all over Japan.
edits.after: According to the Chips' reports, Dendoh's batteries have already been shipped all over Japan.
edits.reason: Chips refers to the Machine Generals' scouting counterparts, not a person named Chip. Match the established plural term.

edits.speaker: Kirakuni
edits.before: They're weapons for fighting Angels... and they run on an external power supply, just like Dendoh.
edits.after: They're weapons for fighting Angels... and they run on electricity, just like Dendoh.
edits.reason: The source says electrical power. Remove the added claim that Dendoh also uses an external power supply; its batteries are inside the machine.

edits.speaker: Kirakuni
edits.before: The spare batteries are already empty...! We have to settle this quickly!
edits.after: We're out of spare batteries...! We have to settle this quickly!
edits.reason: Clarify that the spare supply has run out. The source describes an empty stock, not spare batteries sitting there with no charge.

edits.speaker: Makoto
edits.before: Once you're in range, its charged particle cannon hits instantly at 100% accuracy... Humanoid mobile weapons are too risky in close combat.
edits.after: Its charged particle cannon hits at 100% accuracy as soon as you enter range... Close combat in humanoid mobile weapons is too risky.
edits.reason: Clarify that fighting the Angel at close range is risky, rather than describing the weapons themselves as risky. Keep the stated hit rate; shorten to fit the dialogue box.

edits.speaker: Ritsuko
edits.before: It's temporarily frozen on Commander Ikari's orders.
edits.after: Its deployment has been temporarily suspended on Commander Ikari's orders.
edits.reason: The source uses frozen for an administrative hold. State clearly that EVA-02 cannot be deployed, as the next lines explain.

edits.speaker: Altair
edits.before: D-damn you! Leo Circle, to the likes of you...!!
edits.after: D-damn you! How could the likes of you get Leo Circle...!!
edits.reason: Make the villain's shocked, unfinished complaint readable while preserving his contempt and the Data Weapon's name.

edits.speaker: Asuka
edits.before: Besides, this ship's Three Idiots Trio seems alive and well, too. Well, at least I might not get bored.
edits.after: Besides, this ship's trio of idiots seems alive and well, too. Well, at least I might not get bored.
edits.reason: Use the natural phrase trio of idiots for Asuka's recurring insult, consistent with her earlier scene.

edits.speaker: Shinji
edits.before: When you say this ship's Three Idiots Trio... do you mean those guys?
edits.after: When you say this ship's trio of idiots... do you mean those guys?
edits.reason: Match Shinji's quotation of Asuka's corrected insult, so the exchange remains consistent.

edits.speaker: Argo
edits.before: They have power equal to the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings...
edits.after: Members of the Shuffle Alliance have power equal to the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings...
edits.reason: Name the subject of the sentence. The source describes the still-living Shuffle Alliance, not Schwarz and Master Asia from the preceding lines.

edits.speaker: Vega
edits.before: ...It looks like that...
edits.after: ...That sounds like it...
edits.reason: Vega compares the described energy source with something she knows. Avoid implying a visual resemblance when nothing has been shown.

edits.speaker: Barendos
edits.before: Of course you would... You're the man who left your fellow people on Planet Fleed to die and fled to Earth...!
edits.after: Of course you would... You're the man who left his people on Planet Fleed to die and fled to Earth...!
edits.reason: Replaces the unnatural phrase 'fellow people' while preserving Barendos's accusation.

edits.speaker: Asuka
edits.before: What? Is this another Three Idiots Trio?
edits.after: What? Another trio of idiots?
edits.reason: Treats Asuka's insult as ordinary dialogue, consistent with its other appearances, rather than an invented group name.

edits.speaker: Professor Yumi
edits.before: By the way...how is that machine Genzo Umon asked you to build coming along?
edits.after: By the way...how is that machine Dr. Umon asked you to build coming along?
edits.reason: Restores the doctor's title used in the source instead of replacing it with his full name.

edits.speaker: Professor Yumi
edits.before: An Earth-built Spazer created by you, Genzo Umon and me... I can hardly wait for it to be finished.
edits.after: An Earth-built Spazer created by you, Dr. Umon and me... I can hardly wait for it to be finished.
edits.reason: Restores the source's natural reference to Dr. Umon.

edits.speaker: Ginga
edits.before: Zen meditation, huh? Mom made me do that at our Shaolin kung fu dojo once, too. Man, it makes your legs go numb.
edits.after: Zen meditation, huh? Mom made me do that at our Shorinji Kempo dojo once, too. Man, it makes your legs go numb.
edits.reason: Uses the established name of Ginga's martial art, consistent with the other Dendoh scenes. Shorinji Kempo is distinct from Shaolin kung fu. https://www.shorinjikempo.or.jp/en/what/discipline

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: Wait, Captain!!
edits.after: Wait, Commander!!
edits.reason: Uses Albero's squad-leader title consistently across Chapter 11.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: Captain...!!
edits.after: Commander...!!
edits.reason: Uses Albero's squad-leader title consistently across Chapter 11.

edits.speaker: Albero
edits.before: So this is NERV's general-purpose humanoid weapon built for decisive battle I've heard about...! You too shall become food for Medius!
edits.after: So this is NERV's rumored general-purpose humanoid weapon for decisive battle...! You too shall feed the Medius's growth!
edits.reason: Restructures an awkward chain of modifiers and preserves both the Evangelion description and Albero's threat.

edits.speaker: Albero
edits.before: Or rather, you're a Second Lieutenant now.
edits.after: Or rather, you're an Ensign now.
edits.reason: Uses Hugo's established translated rank, consistent with the project glossary and earlier chapters.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: I don't know why the Captain stole the Medius Locus... or why he attacked us.
edits.after: I don't know why the Commander stole the Medius Locus... or why he attacked us.
edits.reason: Uses Commander for Albero's role as squad leader, consistent with his introduction; this is not a statement of his military rank.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: That's also... what the Captain taught me.
edits.after: That's also... what the Commander taught me.
edits.reason: Keeps Albero's squad-leader title consistent with his introduction.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: If I hesitate when I fight the Captain... I'll only get myself killed.
edits.after: If I hesitate when I fight the Commander... I'll only get myself killed.
edits.reason: Keeps Albero's squad-leader title consistent with his introduction.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: #女愛称! Don't fall for the enemy's sweet talk! In a real battle...
edits.after: #女愛称! Don't let the enemy get to you! In a real battle...
edits.reason: Fits the actual exchange: the enemy is trying to provoke Aqua with an insult, not flattering or sweet-talking her.

edits.speaker: Shi-Tau
edits.before: They call Fire and Water a pair of Hakke robots...! They say they share the same fate as us sisters...!
edits.after: As if Fire and Water must be paired Hakke robots...! As if they have to share the same fate as us sisters...!
edits.reason: Preserves Shi-Tau's rejection of the claimed bond between the two robots, rather than making it sound like a neutral description.

edits.speaker: Soichi
edits.before: Well... Colonel, we'd like you to take in RahXephon and its pilot, Ayato Kamina.
edits.after: Well... Captain, we'd like you to take in RahXephon and its pilot, Ayato Kamina.
edits.reason: Uses Bright's established naval rank, consistent with the same scene's Captain Bright Noa reference and the project glossary decision.

edits.speaker: #男愛称
edits.before: Get out of the way! Ginga and Hokuto are getting away!!
edits.after: Get out of the way! They're taking Ginga and Hokuto away!!
edits.reason: Makes clear that Ginga and Hokuto are being abducted, rather than escaping from their allies.

edits.speaker: Misato
edits.before: And Second Lieutenant #男愛称... Since you have a mission to pursue the Medius Locus...
edits.after: And Ensign #男愛称... Since you have a mission to pursue the Medius Locus...
edits.reason: Uses Hugo's established translated rank, consistent with the glossary and earlier chapters.

edits.before: I-I've lost... A captain who's younger than me...
edits.after: I-I've been outdone... A captain younger than me...
edits.reason: Beecha is comparing himself with a younger captain, not reporting a battle defeat.
edits.speaker: Beecha

edits.before: Sigh... I'm... going to drag up the average age again, aren't I...?
edits.after: Sigh... I'm... going to push up the average age again, aren't I...?
edits.reason: Use a natural expression for raising the crew's average age.
edits.speaker: #女愛称

edits.before: Listen, brat. We'll keep a close watch on you. Trying to escape won't do you any good, right?
edits.after: Listen, brat. We'll keep a close watch on you. Don't bother trying to escape, got it?
